issues.description: Renaming audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a breaking API change without deprecation alias
issues.detail: The changelog notes the rename, but FastAPIWebsocketParams previously exposed audio_packet_bytes. Removing it outright will break any existing user code that passes that kwarg. Provide a deprecated alias (with a warning) or document the breaking change explicitly in release notes for the major version.

issues.description: Non-audio payloads are dropped when fixed_audio_packet_size is set
issues.detail: In _write_frame, when fixed_audio_packet_size is configured and payload is bytes, the code returns after handling the buffer. But if payload is a str (e.g. JSON control message from the serializer), it falls through to send. However, the early `return` after the while loop means small bytes payloads that don't yet fill a packet silently never go out except via buffering — fine — but the branch needs verification that mixed binary/text ordering is preserved.

issues.description: Buffer not flushed on shutdown or end-of-stream, leaking trailing audio
issues.detail: _audio_send_buffer accumulates a remainder smaller than packet_bytes that is never flushed when the session ends or on EndFrame. This means the tail of the last utterance is silently dropped. Consider padding with silence and flushing on stop/cleanup, or at minimum documenting the truncation behavior.

issues.description: VonageFrameSerializer.serialize return type annotation uses PEP 604 union without future import
issues.detail: The return annotation `str | bytes | None` and `str | bytes` parameter require Python 3.10+ at runtime when evaluated. If pipecat still supports 3.9 (check pyproject), this will raise TypeError on import. Either add `from __future__ import annotations` or confirm 3.10 minimum.

issues.description: Pacing logic (_send_interval/_next_send_time) is not applied to chunked sends
issues.detail: When fixed_audio_packet_size is set, the while loop sends multiple chunks back-to-back with no real-time pacing between them. The PR description says this supports 'real-time pacing,' but only the buffering side is implemented. Vonage may reject bursts that violate 20ms cadence; ensure pacing/sleep between emitted packets if required.

issues.description: Copyright header says '2024-2025' but file is new in 2026
issues.detail: The new vonage.py header reads `Copyright (c) 2024-2025, Daily`. Today's date is 2026; update the range or follow whatever the repo convention is for new files added this year.

review.summary: The Vonage serializer is straightforward and well-structured, but the FastAPI transport changes introduce a breaking rename (audio_packet_bytes -> fixed_audio_packet_size) without an alias, and the chunking logic has two real gaps: no flush of the trailing remainder on shutdown/EndFrame, and no pacing between back-to-back chunk sends despite the PR claiming 'real-time pacing.' Minor issues include PEP 604 syntax that may break older Python and a stale copyright header. Recommend addressing the breaking rename and the buffer-flush/pacing semantics before merge.
